semiconductor_relevance: High — Taiwan Mitsui Chemicals, Inc. provides critical materials and gases essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Taiwan Mitsui Chemicals, Inc. is a key supplier of materials and gases for the semiconductor industry. They offer products such as ICROS™ Tape for wafer back-grinding, non-dust photomask pellicles for lithography, and high purity specialty gases like NF3 and SiH4, which are crucial for semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: ICROS™ Tape for wafer surface back-grinding
Non-dust photomask pellicles for immersion lithography
High purity specialty gases (NF3, SiH4, Si2H6, SiF4)
Engineering plastics with high heat resistance and anti-abrasion properties

regional_presence.Taiwan: Taiwan Mitsui Chemicals, Inc. operates in Taiwan, focusing on providing materials and gases for the semiconductor industry.
